rationale: In the middle campaign, the incumbent-to-GP-maximum gap is 1.47, median uncertainty is 1.67, 118 scaffolds have been observed, the last batch mean was 8.02. This supports a mixed batch with an exploration majority while preserving the available hedge channels.
